facts.fact: UNU-EGOV, in a report of 2026-09-23, says its Project Document for the Implementation of the National Digital Transformation Strategy for Guinea-Bissau, designed to set priorities, define governance structures and identify partners and resources, was discussed at a visit by a Guinea-Bissau ministry delegation on 2026-09-09.
